sections.text:
1 Man setzt die Hs., gewöhnlich in’s XI Jahrh.; ich möchte nicht entschieden in
Abrede stellen, dass sie 907 geschrieben sein kann, vgl. f. 35v die Notiz über Photios
[Kroll, l. c.].
2 F: 145-152v ex Ptolemaei Tetrabiblo paucis mutatis excerpta sunt (cap. II, 10;
I, 9, 11, 15-19; II, 11). Contulit Boll.
sections.en:
1 One places the ms., usually in the 11th century; I would not decidedly
deny that it could have been written in 907, cf. f. 35v the note about Photios
[Kroll, l. c.].
2 F: 145-152v are excerpted from Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos with few changes (cap. II, 10;
I, 9, 11, 15-19; II, 11). Boll collated.

summary.headline: Florentine Manuscript Astrological Contents
summary.text: Catalog entry for a Florentine astrological manuscript, listing material on fixed-star epochs, astrolabe instruction, planetary ages and years, zodiacal years, dodecatemoria, cardinal centers, configurations, exaltations, terms according to Ptolemy and the Egyptians, meteors, and lunar thunderbolts. The notes identify excerpts from Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos and material attributed to Labeo, Syrus, and Paul of Alexandria.
